source_title: Prices in DRAM Market Will Keep Rising Through 2017 as Annual Bit Supply Is Projected to Expand by Less Than 20%, Says TrendForce
claim_relevant_visible_text: In terms of wafer capacity, next year’s overall level will be about the same as this year’s.
researcher_paraphrase: DRAMeXchange expected overall DRAM wafer capacity in 2017 to remain roughly flat versus 2016, with bit growth coming mainly from process migration.
precision_guard: This is a December 2016 industry forecast about 2017 wafer capacity, not a realized 2017 capacity measurement and not evidence of supplier coordination.
authority_boundary: TrendForce/DRAMeXchange is methodological-primary for its own industry forecast and market model, not a primary supplier production ledger.
